IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTool_Close_2: Give me a day and I'll fix this place up.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Far_3: Haven't seen one of these in a while.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Near_2: I used to be good at this.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Close_1: You'll lose. Just so you know.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGame_Close_3: A quiet evening with you. I'd like that.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRead_Close_1: I'll read it to you, if you want.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveRead_Close_3: Something to think about besides all this.
IGUI_NotAlone_OptTorchTip: Off: she never uses her flashlight. Auto: she switches it on when it is dark.
IGUI_NotAlone_OptTorchTipMale: Off: he never uses his flashlight. Auto: he switches it on when it is dark.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Near_1: My light died. Got a spare battery?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Near_2: Flashlight's dead. I'll need a battery.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Close_1: There goes my light. I'll swap the battery when I can.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchDead_Close_2: Dead. I'll change it once it's quiet.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchReload_Far_1: Found a cell. Fitting it now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Near_1: A flashlight - thanks, I'll keep it handy.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Near_2: Now I can see where we're going.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Close_1: You're looking after me. Thank you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorch_Close_2: A light of my own. I'll take good care of it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Far_: A flashlight - but there's no battery in it.
Dead flashlight. I'll need a cell.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Near: Thanks, but it's empty. Got a battery?
No battery in this one. I'll need a fresh cell.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTorchEmpty_Clos: It's dead, but I appreciate it. A battery and it's good.
Empty flashlight - I'll fit a cell when you have one.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Near_1: This cell's nearly done. I'll need a fresh one soon.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Near_2: Light's fading - got a spare battery?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Close_1: My flashlight's getting weak. Just so you know.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_EvTorchLow_Close_2: I've been burning through this battery. A fresh one soon would help.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Near_1: Wood or metal — either way, useful.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Near_2: Now we can patch something up.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Near_3: I'll sort it with the rest.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMaterial_Close_: You bring home the pieces and I'll make them fit.
Good — we rebuild a little at a time.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Near: A way to make fire. That matters.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFireSource_Clos: You keep us warm. I notice.
Fire and food. You think ahead.
Thank you. Safety, handed to me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Nea: Parts for something. I'll hang onto it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveElectronics_Clo: Little pieces, bigger plans. I see you.
Thank you. I'll keep it safe.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Near_1: A radio? We might reach someone.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Near_2: Good. Silence is worse than static.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Close_1: A radio. Maybe the world's still out there.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Close_2: If anyone's left, we'll find them. Together.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveComms_Close_3: Thank you. A voice besides yours.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Far_2: Now we know where we're going.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Close_1: A map. Let's find someplace better.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Close_2: We'll trace a road out of here together.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMap_Close_3: Thank you. I like knowing where we stand.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFun_Close_2: A game. I'll go easy on you. Maybe.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFun_Close_3: Thank you. Normal, for an hour.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Close_1: You and me, then. First to ten.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Close_2: I haven't run for fun in years.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSports_Close_3: Thank you. It feels good to play.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveInstrument_Clos: You thought of me when you saw this.
I'll play for you. Only you.
Thank you. You gave me back a part of myself.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Close_1: You thought of me. Soft, fragile me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Close_2: I'll hold it when it's bad. Don't tell.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTeddy_Close_3: Thank you. It helps more than you know.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Near_1: A memento. I'll keep it safe.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Near_2: Good to remember there was a before.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Close_1: You found something worth keeping. For me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Close_2: I'll keep it close. Like I keep you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMemento_Close_3: Thank you. Proof the world was real.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Near_1: A pot or a pan? Now we eat better.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Close_1: You want a real dinner. So do I.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Close_2: I'll cook. You eat. That's the deal.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCooking_Close_3: Thank you. Let's make this place a home.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveGardening_Close: You want to grow things with me.
A garden. Somewhere to stay. With you.
Thank you. I'll grow us something.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Near_1: A rod? Been a while since I fished.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Near_2: Good. Quiet days by the water.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Near_3: I'll try not to fall in.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Close_1: You and me, then. A quiet river.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFishing_Close_3: Thank you. A slow day sounds like heaven.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Near_1: A trap? Smart. Food that comes to us.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveTrapping_Close_: You want us fed without a fight. I like that.
I'll set them. You check them. Deal?
Thank you. A clever kind of patience.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Nea: Auto parts. So we're fixing something.
Good. Maybe it runs after this.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveVehiclePart_Clo: You want us moving again. I'm with you.
A part for the car. A way out. Thank you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Far_2: For the road, I take it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Near_1: A tent? Good, my back's had enough.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Close_1: Somewhere to sleep that isn't the ground.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCamping_Close_2: A tent. A little roof of our own.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveContainer_Close: Room for your things too. You know that.
A box for our life. I'll keep it neat.
Thank you. More hands, more pockets.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Near_: A chair? Good, we're not savages.
Something to make a room feel lived in.
I'll find a place for it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveFurniture_Close: You're making a home. I noticed.
A place to sit. With you. Finally.
Thank you. This is what staying looks like.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Near_1: Paint? Good. The walls need it. So does the floor.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Near_2: A fresh coat. Nobody asks what's under it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Near_3: I'll take a brush to this place.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Close_1: Paint. We cover the blood with something brighter.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Close_2: A fresh coat hides a lot. Around here, that's useful.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceivePaint_Close_3: Thank you. Better to paint the walls than explain them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Near_1: Good. The door's been too easy.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveSecurity_Close_: You want us safe. I want that too.
Locks between us and them. Thank you.
I'll sleep better with this in place.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Far_: A gun part? I don't shoot.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Near: Weapon parts. You and your guns.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveWeaponPart_Clos: Another piece for the guns I won't touch.
It's for you, not me. I'll hold it anyway.
I don't like these. But I like that you carry them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Near_2: You and me, then. A little fun.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Close_1: You still see someone worth prettifying.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Close_2: A little color before the world ends. I'll take it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveMakeup_Close_3: Thank you. I'd forgotten about this part of me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Near: Parts. Good for something, I'm sure.
Hides and bones. We'll use them.
I'll sort it with the rest.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimalPart_Clos: Nothing wasted. You learned that out here.
Hide and bone. We'll make something of it.
Thank you. Everything has a use now.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Near_2: Soft, small. I'll keep it close.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Near_3: You thought to bring it to me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Close_1: You brought me something alive. Thank you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Close_2: A tiny life. I'll protect it. Like you protect me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveAnimal_Close_3: I'll keep it. A little hope with fur.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Near_3: Bury it or drop it. Not on me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Close_1: A body. I don't like this, and I don't like it near you.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Close_2: Why would you hand me this? Get it away.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCorpse_Close_3: No. Not this. Not after everything.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Near_: Home things. Good, we're settling in.
I'll find a place for it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveHousehold_Close: You're making this ours, piece by piece.
Little things for the house. I notice.
Thank you. It feels like a home already.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Far_1: Why are you giving me this?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Far_2: I don't know you well enough for that.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Near_1: That's... unexpected. I'll take them anyway.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Near_2: You're brazen. I'll allow it. Once.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Near_3: I don't know what to say to that.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Close_2: For me? Careful — I might take that as a hint.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveUndies_Close_3: Well then. You have my attention.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Far_1: Those will kill you. Faster than the dead will.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Far_2: Filthy habit. Keep them away from me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Near_1: You're still smoking? After all this?
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Near_2: I'll hold them. I won't watch you use them.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Near_3: That's a slow death. You know it is.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Close_1: I'm not losing you to a cigarette. Not after everything.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveCigs_Close_3: You survived the end of the world. Don't let this finish it.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Far_3: I'll take it. Won't touch it more than I must.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Near_1: Bait? Good. Fish won't catch themselves.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Near_2: Worms and grubs. I'll bait the line.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Near_3: Useful. Just keep them off me.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Close_1: Bait. Tonight we might eat like kings.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Close_2: You bring the worms, I'll bring the patience.
IGUI_NotAlone_Soc_ReceiveBait_Close_3: I'll bait the line. You reel them in.
